entities.summary: Sylwia Grzeszczak (b. 1989-04-07, Poznań) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Poznań and Poland. Known in the fields of poland, composers & musicians, europe.
